name: deck-sprint-review
description: Drafts a sprint review deck of five slides at most in Claude Slides, with the sprint goal and whether it was met, what is done and ready to try, a hands-on order for the demo, the questions for stakeholders and the backlog changes to agree. Use for "run deck-sprint-review", "sprint review deck", "sprint review slides", "demo day slides", "our sprint review is a slide show", "stakeholders never give feedback in the review", "prepare the sprint review", part of the Claude Slides for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
